description: Fair Offer certification for an x402 API: every claim in your 402's fair-offer block checked against live behaviour. Your public receipts are reconciled against Base, your free sample is attested, the block is checked against the 0.2 schema and across two requests, and the listing price against the Bazaar; priced at 5 cents or less, your route is also paid once to check that failed calls are free and results carry signed receipts. Pass or fail, the signed result is published at a public URL. Price: $1.00 in USDC per call, paid with x402 inside the tool call. Or send a Skyfire pay or kya-pay token in the kyapay-token header (or in this tool's kyapay-token argument), and this tool charges $1.00 to it. Failed calls aren't charged.

kyapay-token.description: A Skyfire pay or kya-pay token made for Agoranome's service, from a client that can't set the kyapay-token header. Leave it out when paying with x402 or the header.
